answer: Require each new identity to be endorsed by three established agents from three different trust clusters, with each endorser able to endorse only one newcomer per epoch. A fake therefore needs three separate reputable backers, and a farm quickly exhausts the endorsers it controls: the next fakes need entirely new clusters, so the cost in recruited trust rises with every fake. A plume of willow branches cannot all drink from one oasis; each new identity must find its own water.
